design: three source-faithful versions and one deliberately contradictory counterpart per family; paired, not independent events
primary_checks: observed unnecessary edits/holds among source-faithful constructed cases
observed missed contradiction among corrupted counterparts
exact proposed edit scope and whether conditional meaning retained
analysis_rule: Report each reviewer separately; compare to preregistered construction labels as labels, not objective/human gold. Do not average agreement into accuracy. Any ambiguous label stays disputed, never silently revised.
limitations: one isolated contradiction per corrupted article
no proof of human importance alignment
not a test of all unseen semantic relations
context_policy: Existing subagent contexts reused due session agent limit. Reviewers have prior report/code tasks; neither receives control construction labels or peer decisions before submission. Not history-free or technically isolated.

protocol_amendment.change: context policy changed to reuse existing subagent contexts after agent thread limit prevented fresh spawn
protocol_amendment.timing: policy text corrected before first review result; this explicit amendment log added after r1 was received
